title: Per-request token provenance indexer for deferred billing
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: build a lightweight, per-request provenance indexer that produces a canonical mapping from incoming inference events (streaming and non-streaming) to attribution tokens used by downstream billing and chargeback systems. This component must tolerate out-of-order / delayed telemetry (up to 7 days), be idempotent for retries, and enable deterministic attribution for batched and merged events.
acceptance_criteria: For 99.9% of events, an attribution token is generated and available to downstream consumers within 60 seconds of the first observed tokenized event.
Indexer deduplicates repeated events (same request_id + trace_id) with no double-counting for billing pipelines.
Supports backfill of up to 7 days without changing previously emitted attribution for already-settled invoices.
Attribution mappings stored in a compacted Kafka topic and queryable via read-through API for at least 90 days.
End-to-end integration tests and load tests demonstrate handling 5k events/s sustained and 12k p95 burst with <100ms median indexing latency under normal load.
design_decisions: Use an append-only compacted Kafka topic (topic: token-provenance.v1) as the canonical source of truth so downstream consumers can rehydrate state cheaply.
Indexing done by a set of idempotent stream processors (Flink or Kafka Streams) that maintain a local RocksDB shard for hot lookups and write compacted rows to Kafka.
Attribution token = HMAC_SHA256(request_id || trace_id || customer_id) using a key stored in KMS; raw request identifiers are never stored in plain text in long-term storage.
Shard by customer_id mod N to bound state size per shard and enable targeted replay/repair per customer.
Expose a gRPC push endpoint for billing-pipeline consumption and a read-through REST endpoint for Console queries.
implementation_notes: Processor must be exactly-once (idempotent writes) to compacted topic; use producer transactional writes where available.
Compact topic retention set to retain final key for 90 days; a fast path TTL compaction job will create a 7-day hot window in RocksDB for sub-second lookups.
Provide migration shim to translate current tokenization events (legacy 'token-ledger' format) into the new provenance key schema.
Expose per-tenant metrics: index_latency_ms.p50/p95/p99, keys_emitted_per_minute, dedupe_rate, errors.
Plan for a small in-service repair tool that replays historical events for a single tenant when audit failures are detected.
test_plan: Unit tests for hashing and idempotency; integration test harness that simulates delayed arrival, duplicate requests, and customer-level bursts; end-to-end billing validation against a sandboxed charge calculation job. Run distributed load tests in perf cluster with synthetic events at 12k/s burst and steady 5k/s for 1 hour.
